title: Conflicts and Solutions in the Practice
subtitle: Dr. Samira & Dr. Malika are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor!

Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika are two passionate dentists. But managing a practice is not always smooth sailing...

Between a patient disputing their fees, an assistant claiming rights, a colleague who doesn't respect the rules, a landlord refusing to carry out work... tensions are inevitable.

The Code of Ethics, the Labor Code, and Law 49-16 offer solutions. But you need to know them.

A management error, and it's the court that comes knocking.

The practice's serenity, the practitioner's reputation, and patient trust rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: The Foundations of Conflict Management - Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika discover the principles of conflict management in the practice: patients, staff, colleagues, landlords. Every situation has its solution.
chapters.debutant2: Disciplinary Procedures - Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika explore disciplinary procedures and appeals. Prevention is the key to a serene practice.
chapters.intermediaire1: Patient Conflict Management - Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika learn to manage complaints and disputes with patients. Communication is the first step in mediation.
chapters.intermediaire2: Staff Conflicts - Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika must manage conflicts with their team. The Labor Code is their guide.
chapters.expert1: Professional Mediation - Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika become mediation experts. They train young dentists in communication and conflict management.
chapters.expert2: Excellence and Transmission - After years of practice, Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika pass on their knowledge. Mediation is the soul of the patient relationship.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika have laid the foundations of conflict management. But the road is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Disciplinary procedures are mastered. Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika are ready to manage conflicts.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Patient conflicts are successfully managed. Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Staff conflicts are under control. Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika are confident.
chapterEndings.expert1: Mediation has become a key skill. Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Samira and Dr. Malika have accomplished their mission. Mediation is the soul of the patient relationship.
